excerpt: Master of Journalism — A.I. and Innovation Concentration (MJ-AIC) Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) is drastically changing the world we live in, and it also brings transformative changes to journalism and media practices. To prepare our graduates for the age of A.I., the JMSC is launching a new A.I. and Innovation concentration. The MJ-AIC* is a new certificate programme introduced for the 2025-2026 academic year within the existing Master of Journalism degree curriculum, now open for applications. The MJ-AIC provides students with foundational knowledge of A.I. and an overview of the latest technology developments as well as its impact on journalism and media. It also offers practical training that aims to enable students to have hands-on skills with the latest A.I. tools to assist their work. *MJ-AIC is part of the Master of Journalism curriculum. Students may declare the A.I. and Innovation concentration upon accepting the 25-26 admission offer. MJ-AIC students will - Meet all the graduation requirements for a standard MJ programme - Complete at least three courses focused on A.I. and Innovation topics - Deliver capstone projects that reflect knowledge and skills on A.I. and Innovation - Receive an MJ degree and an additional AIC certificate upon graduation Sample Schedule for MJ-AIC students Courses available for MJ-AIC students: Compulsory: - JMSC6140 A.I. & media innovation (Fall 2025) Electives: Choose TWO from the following: Fall 2025 - JMSC6113 Data journalism - JMSC6125 Generative A.I. in media applications Spring 2026: - JMSC6041 Covering Technology & A.I. - JMSC6046 A.I. tools for journalists - JMSC6116 Media data analysis - Generative A.I. for Creative Media ** **Course code to be confirmed. This is an advanced course, with JMSC6125 as its prerequisite For more information about the MJ-AIC Please check out our information session recording or contact us at jmscmj@hku.hk.
